text:
niya-docs: Quick thread to coordinate a small "cookbook" page for the Console observability docs. Goal: one-page recipes for mapping old telemetry shapes (trace_key, cost) -> new shape (traceId, estimated_cost_usd) plus snippet variants for Node/Python/Go and a short backport checklist. Filing PR after feedback.
cal-eng: nice. we need that — I keep getting questions in support tickets about which field to read. suggest a tiny mapping table + one-liner migration code per SDK.
phoebe-ml: runtime telemetry changed last release; we intentionally left backwards compat for 2 weeks, but teams are starting to see mismatches. a cookbook will reduce confusion. add a note about nested paths (some responses nest metrics under `telemetry.v1.metrics`).
arthur-sdk: i'll prepare minimal SDK recipes. propose the following Node helper (very small):
```js
function normalizeTelemetry(payload) {
  // prefer new fields, fall back to legacy ones
  return {
    traceId: payload.traceId || payload.trace_key || payload.traceKey,
    costUsd: payload.estimated_cost_usd || payload.estimated_cost || payload.cost_usd
  }
}
```
niya-docs: perfect — that style is exactly what docs should show. i'll add a short paragraph explaining why we prefer `estimated_cost_usd` (currency explicitness) and when to expect old names.
zoe-ux: small UX ask: if we change panel titles in screenshots, include the exact string to copy/paste so product folks can mirror the UI. example: "Cost by trace ID". also prefer sentence case in captions.
arthur-sdk: Python recipe will use dict.get pattern. Go will show struct tags and a tiny mapping function. I'll keep examples idiomatic.
cal-eng: also include a one-line CLI check for folks who want to inspect a raw event: `jq '.telemetry.v1.metrics | {traceId: .traceId, cost: .estimated_cost_usd}' sample_event.json`
phoebe-ml: good idea. add a short note about telemetry versions (v0 vs v1) and how the platform will route older events to the compatibility layer for now.
niya-docs: plan: open PR to `docs/console/observability/cookbook.md`, add recipes folder link `/docs/console/observability/recipes`, include Node/Py/Go snippets, mapping table, migration checklist, and a small screenshot caption update note. tagging @arthur-sdk and @zoe-ux for final review. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9402 (will link once created).
ci-bot: quick reminder: run link-check and code-sample lint in the branch before merge.
arthur-sdk: will push snippet commits to the branch. I'll also add unit-testable examples in the SDK repo to make sure copy stays accurate.
zoe-ux: happy to review captions and alt text. if we change any UI strings we need PM confirmation but small caption wording is fine.
cal-eng: if you want, i can wire a short note into the Release Notes so customers see the change.
niya-docs: great — i'll coordinate release notes and the docs PR. thanks everyone — I'll ping this thread when PR is up for review. :thumbsup:
